add.event: 以 Richardson, Overend and Company 名义创立
add.evidence: The business was founded in 1800 as Richardson, Overend and Company

add.event: 1825年金融危机中，该行得以向众多银行提供短期贷款
add.evidence: During the financial crisis of 1825, the firm was able to make short loans to many other bankers.

add.event: 为恢复流动性改组为有限公司，15英镑股票溢价9英镑发售
add.evidence: the business was incorporated as a limited company in July 1865 and sold its £15 shares at a £9 premium
